actions.mechanism: Separate presence from condition so counting never implies inspection, and previous good condition cannot silently carry forward.
actions.implementation: Use a paper sheet listing ten IDs, presence, condition category or unknown, inspector initials, and time. Start each return’s condition fields as unknown.
actions.check: Record a counted-only return: all ten components show present, all conditions remain unknown, and no inspection initials appear.
actions.risk: Pre-filled condition values could recreate false assurance.

actions.action: Make shift responsibility an acknowledged transfer
actions.mechanism: An explicit acceptance record transfers responsibility for unresolved work without pretending the incoming staff performed earlier inspections.
actions.implementation: Keep the kit sheet in a shared desk binder. Record outgoing owner, incoming owner, acceptance time, and unresolved IDs; transfer ownership only upon acknowledgment.
actions.check: After a simulated shift change, incoming staff must identify the responsible owner and distinguish recorded inspections from pending work.
actions.risk: An absent replacement requires a designated supervisor fallback.

actions.action: Give every missing component an owned next step
actions.mechanism: A persistent exception record prevents missing items from disappearing inside an otherwise finished handoff.
actions.implementation: For each missing ID, record a named staff owner, concrete next action, and deadline. Close the exception only with resolution evidence and staff initials.
actions.check: Remove one component during rehearsal; verify its search or borrower-contact task remains open and owned after the next shift accepts responsibility.
actions.risk: Vague actions or unreviewed deadlines leave exceptions ineffective.

actions.action: Timebox handoffs without clearing unresolved conditions
actions.mechanism: Separate custody acceptance from readiness to lend, allowing fast transfers while incomplete evidence keeps the kit unavailable.
actions.implementation: Reserve the final 30 seconds for recording pending IDs and their owner. Stop by three minutes; mark the kit inspection-pending until every required check resolves.
actions.check: Time a counted-only return: custody transfers within three minutes, conditions remain unknown, and attempted relending is blocked.
actions.risk: Deferred inspections can reduce kit availability and accumulate.
